title: E3 tangent-acquisition logical cost and streaming-equivalence qualification
question: How much real-SWAP corrector work is inherent in the current E3 reference estimator, and how much can be removed by stopping at the first already-defined qualifying adjacent scale pair without changing E3 semantics?

frozen_state_matrix.fgc44: All eight G09D boundary-state estimator results.
frozen_state_matrix.map09: The three G12B MAP09 estimator results at HREF and frozen +/-1e-6 m starts.

logical_cost_model.sample_contract: Current E3 sample acquisition evaluates a participant trial for q/status and a separate raw/corrector diagnostic for execution class at every unique probe head.
logical_cost_model.streaming_rule: Evaluate fixed scales coarse-to-fine with the same cache. After each new scale, compare only the immediately preceding candidate with the new candidate. Stop at the first pair that satisfies the existing E3 <=5% relative slope rule.
logical_cost_model.fused_trial_result_lower_bound: Diagnostic only: count one corrector run per unique head if a future trial API returned q, participant status and execution-class fields from the same physical trial. This is not an implemented or admitted API.

equivalence_gates: For every frozen state, streaming finds AVAILABLE if and only if persisted full-ladder E3 is AVAILABLE.
Streaming selected scale, selected mode, selected slope, confirming scale, confirming mode and confirming slope equal the persisted E3 decision within floating-point tolerance.
Streaming never evaluates a finer scale after the first qualifying adjacent pair.
Logical current implementation cost equals 2 times the unique-head count implied by all persisted fixed scales.
Logical streaming cost equals 2 times the unique-head count needed through its confirming scale.
The fused-trial count is reported only as a lower-bound integration target and does not constitute implementation evidence.

contextual_cost.g11: Report the two live P4 safeguard contractions from G11 separately so tangent acquisition and globalization overhead are not conflated.

interpretation: PASS qualifies streaming early-stop as semantically equivalent to the current research E3 decision rule on the frozen live evidence matrix.
PASS does not qualify a fused production tangent API.
Any source-code optimization or production integration requires a separate work unit and regression against the full reference estimator.
No production HCOF/RHS or coupling source changes are authorized.
